rendererFormattedStrings.varianceDisclaimer: Values are estimated and may vary. The [performance score is calculated](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/performance-scoring/) directly from these metrics.
rendererFormattedStrings.toplevelWarningsMessage: There were issues affecting this run of Lighthouse:
rendererFormattedStrings.lsPerformanceCategoryDescription: [Lighthouse](https://developers.google.com/web/tools/lighthouse/) analysis of the current page on an emulated mobile network. Values are estimated and may vary.

redirects.title: Avoid multiple page redirects
redirects.description: Redirects introduce additional delays before the page can be loaded. [Learn how to avoid page redirects](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/redirects/).

long-tasks.title: Avoid long main-thread tasks
long-tasks.description: Lists the longest tasks on the main thread, useful for identifying worst contributors to input delay. [Learn how to avoid long main-thread tasks](https://third-party-7.test/articles/optimize-long-tasks)

bootup-time.title: Reduce JavaScript execution time
bootup-time.description: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling, and executing JS. You may find delivering smaller JS payloads helps with this. [Learn how to reduce Javascript execution time](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/bootup-time/).

interactive.title: Time to Interactive
interactive.description: Time to Interactive is the amount of time it takes for the page to become fully interactive. [Learn more about the Time to Interactive metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/interactive/).

network-rtt.title: Network Round Trip Times
network-rtt.description: Network round trip times (RTT) have a large impact on performance. If the RTT to an origin is high, it's an indication that servers closer to the user could improve performance. [Learn more about the Round Trip Time](https://third-party-22.test/primer-on-latency-and-bandwidth/).

speed-index.title: Speed Index
speed-index.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).

user-timings.title: User Timing marks and measures
user-timings.description: Consider instrumenting your app with the User Timing API to measure your app's real-world performance during key user experiences. [Learn more about User Timing marks](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/user-timings/).

cache-insight.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
cache-insight.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/cache).

layout-shifts.title: Avoid large layout shifts

Below each item are possible root causes that led to the layout shift. Some of these layout shifts may not be included in the CLS metric value due to [windowing](https://third-party-7.test/articles/cls#what_is_cls). [Learn how to improve CLS](https://third-party-7.test/articles/optimize-cls)

unminified-css.title: Minify CSS
unminified-css.description: Minifying CSS files can reduce network payload sizes. [Learn how to minify CSS](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/unminified-css/).

unsized-images.title: Image elements do not have explicit `width` and `height`
unsized-images.description: Set an explicit width and height on image elements to reduce layout shifts and improve CLS. [Learn how to set image dimensions](https://third-party-7.test/articles/optimize-cls#images_without_dimensions)

dom-size-insight.title: Optimize DOM size

node.snippet: <span>
<body class="layout-main bg-white on-desktop on-chrome">

dom-size-insight.description: A large DOM can increase the duration of style calculations and layout reflows, impacting page responsiveness. A large DOM will also increase memory usage. [Learn how to avoid an excessive DOM size](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/dom-size).

network-requests.title: Network Requests
network-requests.description: Lists the network requests that were made during page load.

resource-summary.title: Resources Summary
resource-summary.description: Aggregates all network requests and groups them by type

unused-css-rules.title: Reduce unused CSS
unused-css-rules.description: Reduce unused rules from stylesheets and defer CSS not used for above-the-fold content to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused CSS](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-css-rules/).

viewport-insight.title: Optimize viewport for mobile

node.snippet: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=5, viewport-fit=cover">

viewport-insight.description: Tap interactions may be [delayed by up to 300 ms](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/viewport) if the viewport is not optimized for mobile.

main-thread-tasks.title: Tasks
main-thread-tasks.description: Lists the toplevel main thread tasks that executed during page load.

max-potential-fid.title: Max Potential First Input Delay
max-potential-fid.description: The maximum potential First Input Delay that your users could experience is the duration of the longest task. [Learn more about the Maximum Potential First Input Delay metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-max-potential-fid/).

total-byte-weight.title: Avoid enormous network payloads
total-byte-weight.description: Large network payloads cost users real money and are highly correlated with long load times. [Learn how to reduce payload sizes](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/total-byte-weight/).

unused-javascript.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
unused-javascript.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused JavaScript](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-javascript/).

total-blocking-time.title: Total Blocking Time
total-blocking-time.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).

cls-culprits-insight.title: Layout shift culprits

<div data-v-1086ef07="" class="input-group border d-flex align-items-center rounded-pill overflow-hidden …">

cls-culprits-insight.description: Layout shifts occur when elements move absent any user interaction. [Investigate the causes of layout shifts](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/cls-culprit), such as elements being added, removed, or their fonts changing as the page loads.

font-display-insight.title: Font display
font-display-insight.description: Consider setting [font-display](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/font-display) to swap or optional to ensure text is consistently visible. swap can be further optimized to mitigate layout shifts with [font metric overrides](https://third-party-1.test/blog/font-fallbacks).

server-response-time.title: Initial server response time was short
server-response-time.description: Keep the server response time for the main document short because all other requests depend on it. [Learn more about the Time to First Byte metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/time-to-first-byte/).

forced-reflow-insight.title: Forced reflow
forced-reflow-insight.description: A forced reflow occurs when JavaScript queries geometric properties (such as offsetWidth) after styles have been invalidated by a change to the DOM state. This can result in poor performance. Learn more about [forced reflows](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/forced-reflow) and possible mitigations.

inp-breakdown-insight.title: INP breakdown
inp-breakdown-insight.description: Start investigating [how to improve INP](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/inp-breakdown) by looking at the longest subpart.

third-parties-insight.title: 3rd parties
third-parties-insight.description: 3rd party code can significantly impact load performance. [Reduce and defer loading of 3rd party code](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/third-parties) to prioritize your page's content.

unminified-javascript.title: Minify JavaScript
unminified-javascript.description: Minifying JavaScript files can reduce payload sizes and script parse time. [Learn how to minify JavaScript](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/unminified-javascript/).

first-contentful-paint.title: First Contentful Paint
first-contentful-paint.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).

image-delivery-insight.description: Reducing the download time of images can improve the perceived load time of the page and LCP. [Learn more about optimizing image size](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/image-delivery)

network-server-latency.title: Server Backend Latencies
network-server-latency.description: Server latencies can impact web performance. If the server latency of an origin is high, it's an indication the server is overloaded or has poor backend performance. [Learn more about server response time](https://third-party-22.test/primer-on-web-performance/#analyzing-the-resource-waterfall).

cumulative-layout-shift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cumulative-layout-shift.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://third-party-7.test/articles/cls).

render-blocking-insight.title: Render blocking requests
render-blocking-insight.description: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

document-latency-insight.title: Document request latency
document-latency-insight.description: Your first network request is the most important. [Reduce its latency](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/document-latency) by avoiding redirects, ensuring a fast server response, and enabling text compression.

largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)

legacy-javascript-insight.title: Legacy JavaScript
legacy-javascript-insight.description: Polyfills and transforms enable older browsers to use new JavaScript features. However, many aren't necessary for modern browsers. Consider modifying your JavaScript build process to not transpile [Baseline](https://third-party-7.test/articles/baseline-and-polyfills) features, unless you know you must support older browsers. [Learn why most sites can deploy ES6+ code without transpiling](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/legacy-javascript)

mainthread-work-breakdown.title: Minimize main-thread work
mainthread-work-breakdown.description: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling and executing JS. You may find delivering smaller JS payloads helps with this. [Learn how to minimize main-thread work](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/mainthread-work-breakdown/)

non-composited-animations.title: Avoid non-composited animations
non-composited-animations.description: Animations which are not composited can be janky and increase CLS. [Learn how to avoid non-composited animations](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/non-composited-animations/)

duplicated-javascript-insight.title: Duplicated JavaScript
duplicated-javascript-insight.description: Remove large, [duplicate JavaScript modules](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/duplicated-javascript) from bundles to reduce unnecessary bytes consumed by network activity.

items.title: Preconnect candidates
items.description: Add [preconnect](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/uses-rel-preconnect/) hints to your most important origins, but try to use no more than 4.

network-dependency-tree-insight.description: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://third-party-1.test/docs/performance/insights/network-dependency-tree) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: These insights are also available in the Chrome DevTools Performance Panel - [record a trace](https://third-party-1.test/docs/devtools/performance/reference) to view more detailed information.

a11y-aria.title: ARIA
a11y-aria.description: These are opportunities to improve the usage of ARIA in your application which may enhance the experience for users of assistive technology, like a screen reader.

seo-crawl.title: Crawling and Indexing
seo-crawl.description: To appear in search results, crawlers need access to your app.

seo-mobile.title: Mobile Friendly
seo-mobile.description: Make sure your pages are mobile friendly so users don’t have to pinch or zoom in order to read the content pages. [Learn how to make pages mobile-friendly](https://developers.google.com/search/mobile-sites/).

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: More information about the performance of your application. These numbers don't [directly affect](https://third-party-1.test/docs/lighthouse/performance/performance-scoring/) the Performance score.

seo-content.title: Content Best Practices
seo-content.description: Format your HTML in a way that enables crawlers to better understand your app’s content.

a11y-language.title: Internationalization and localization
a11y-language.description: These are opportunities to improve the interpretation of your content by users in different locales.

a11y-navigation.title: Navigation
a11y-navigation.description: These are opportunities to improve keyboard navigation in your application.

a11y-audio-video.title: Audio and video
a11y-audio-video.description: These are opportunities to provide alternative content for audio and video. This may improve the experience for users with hearing or vision impairments.

a11y-names-labels.title: Names and labels
a11y-names-labels.description: These are opportunities to improve the semantics of the controls in your application. This may enhance the experience for users of assistive technology, like a screen reader.

a11y-tables-lists.title: Tables and lists
a11y-tables-lists.description: These are opportunities to improve the experience of reading tabular or list data using assistive technology, like a screen reader.

a11y-best-practices.title: Best practices
a11y-best-practices.description: These items highlight common accessibility best practices.

a11y-color-contrast.title: Contrast
a11y-color-contrast.description: These are opportunities to improve the legibility of your content.
